newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products edge up on crude but activity thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products edge up on crude but activity thin.

text.p: NWE oil products were gently firmer on Monday morning tracking higher crude oil.
But early activity was thin although better demand for bunkering fuel was reported in Rotterdam. "We see about 15,000 tonnes of demand and it's building," said one of Rotterdam's biggest suppliers.
Prices were either side of $81.75 a tonne for high sulphur fuel barges with several buyers facing a single seller, traders said.
Gasoline swaps edged up $1 a tonne to $180 for July or August but physical was quiet.
Gas oil was up about $2 a tonne on futures but physical barges held steady at a discount of 50 cents to the screen.
